name: Learning to Ride
summary: Kildar offers to teach you wolf riding for a fee. Training opens the way to a free mount from Ogunaro and later purchases of additional mounts.

sections.title: Wolf Riding
sections.body: Ogunaro will provide you with a free mount after Kildar trains you. You can then purchase additional mounts. Other creatures need their own riding skills, taught by trainers you must find.

sections.title: Bond and Skill
sections.body: Kildar teaches you to ride one of the orcs' wolves for a fee. Learning the bond between wolf and rider is part of his training, and riding these creatures takes resolve.

faq.q: What does wolf riding training cost?
faq.answer: Kildar offers the training for a fee; no amount is stated here.

faq.q: Who gives me a mount after training?
faq.answer: Ogunaro provides you with a free mount once you have trained with Kildar.
After training, you can purchase additional mounts.

faq.q: Do other creatures need different riding skills?
faq.answer: Each creature requires its own riding skill, and you will need to find trainers for them.

faq.q: What is part of riding a wolf?
faq.answer: Kildar's training helps you learn the bond between wolf and rider.
